data.value: Downloads and uploads delay everything else (bufferbloat). Turn on Smart Queue Management (SQM) or QoS in your router, if it has it.

data.comment: Energy-Efficient Ethernet is a driver setting name.

data.value: It can add delay spikes. In Device Manager, open your Ethernet adapter and, on the Advanced tab, set Energy-Efficient Ethernet to Off.
data.comment: Use the Windows Device Manager wording of the target language for the tab name.

data.value: Power saving may slow your connection
data.comment: Best-practice title.

data.value: Energy saver and battery power saving slow down Wi-Fi. Plug in your PC, or in Settings > System > Power & battery, turn off Energy saver and set Power mode to Balanced.
data.comment: Use the Windows 11 Settings wording of the target language for the page and setting names.

data.value: This connection is set as metered
